entry.name: live.numbox
entry.description: The live.numbox object is a number box used to display, input, and output numbers.

attributes.name: active
attributes.digest: Active mode enable
attributes.description: Toggles the object's active mode. When theattribute is set to 0, the mouse action does not cause output, and the inactive colors are used.

attributes.name: activebgcolor
attributes.digest: Background color (active)
attributes.description: Sets the background color off displayed when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: activeslidercolor
attributes.digest: Slider color
attributes.description: Sets the slider color displayed when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: activetricolor
attributes.digest: Triangle Color Default (Active)
attributes.description: Sets the triangle color displayed when the actual value is equal to thevalue.

attributes.name: activetricolor2
attributes.digest: Triangle color (active)
attributes.description: Sets the triangle color displayed when the actual value is different from thevalue and theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.digest: Connect to Parameter
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Click and drag to change number values
messages.description: Click and drag thedisplay to change the value. Hold down the Shift key for more precise mouse control.If theobject is set to store an initial value (set by checking the Initial Enable option in the object's Inspector), double-clicking in the triangle region will restore that value.

messages.name: assign
messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out theobject's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, themessage will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
messages.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Store, display, and send a number
messages.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed by theobject and sent out the outlet.

messages.name: init
messages.digest: Restores and outputs the initial value
messages.description: Restores and outputs the initial value.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Store, display, and send a number
messages.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed by theobject and sent out the outlet.

messages.name: outputvalue
messages.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
messages.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

messages.name: rawfloat
messages.digest: Store a raw normalized value, convert to real, display, and output
messages.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, stored, displayed by, and the current value is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Sets the current value without causing any output
messages.description: Sets the current value without causing any output.
